title: ENS/ENSET protests over recruitment of teacher-training graduates
location: Antananarivo (Ampefiloha, Andavamamba) and Antsiranana; ENS branch strike activity is also reported in Toliara and Fianarantsoa, while Toamasina appears inconsistently in branch lists
organizer: ENS/ENSET student groups; cross-branch coordination unresolved
participants_original: No attendance estimate reported in sources reviewed.
threshold_50_evidence: Street demonstrations and road obstruction are documented, but no source gives a crowd estimate or establishes >=50.

start_date.summary: Antananarivo action began Jan6; Antsiranana ENSET students joined Jan7.

location.summary: Specific street/campus demonstrations are reported in Antananarivo and Antsiranana. Midi reports strike activity across ENS branches including Toliara and Fianarantsoa; a Toamasina listing is inconsistent, and separate public street assemblies at those branches are not established.

organizer.summary: ENS/ENSET student groups and representatives; coordination across branches unresolved.

demands.summary: Hiring teacher-training graduates into Ministry of Education jobs; provisional labor category, no wage amount demand reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Demonstrations/road obstruction confirm gatherings but do not quantify attendees; 50+ unproven.

end_date.summary: Leaders declared demonstrations suspended by Jan10 publication; exact physical end unknown.

protester_violence.summary: Antsiranana account reports student stone throwing and burning; localized to that gathering.

state_response.summary: Tear gas, arrests and meetings/negotiations with ministry/Presidency and protest representatives reported.

notes: Reports support a Jan6 Antananarivo action and Jan7 Antsiranana participation under a shared recruitment grievance, but exact national-campaign structure is uncertain. Suspension reported by Jan10; physical end not confirmed. Antsiranana violence is localized. November 2020's roughly 600 affected graduates are not participants and are not evidence of January continuity. Midi reports ENS strike activity at branches in Toliara and Fianarantsoa, but street demonstrations are specifically described in Antananarivo and Antsiranana; branch-list discrepancies remain and no separate 50+ assembly is established in the other cities.
open_questions: Were Antananarivo and Antsiranana one coordinated campaign or separate local events?
What was the actual physical end date after suspension was announced?
Did other named ENS branches hold January public gatherings?

title: Medical students’ announced January action over scholarships, internship allowances and campus conditions
participants_original: No attendance estimate reported; physical occurrence of the announced January gathering is not established.
threshold_50_evidence: No opened source verifies an executed gathering or provides attendance. The Jan22 search-only excerpt claims an on-campus manifestation but gives no occurrence date and cannot establish 50+.

start_date.summary: S007 (Jan20) and S008 (Jan21) announce/plan an action for Jan21; neither establishes execution. S009 is blocked on direct open; its Jan22 search-only excerpt claims a campus manifestation without dating it. Physical start date is unknown.

location.summary: Ankatso campus is the announced/planned setting; the blocked Jan22 search excerpt describes a manifestation within campus, but actual occurrence and date remain unverified.

organizer.summary: The medical-student association announced the planned action; the search-only Jan22 excerpt attributes a manifestation to students.

demands.summary: Sources report planned demands concerning scholarship arrears, internship/equipment allowances, tuition and campus water/sanitation. Categories provisionally map internship allowance to labor dispute and tuition/cost concerns to price/fee policy; these are not proof of an executed gathering.

participants_original.summary: No demonstrator estimate is reported; scholarship beneficiaries are not treated as attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No opened source verifies an executed gathering or provides a crowd estimate; the undated search-only manifestation excerpt does not establish 50+.

end_date.summary: A March retrospective refers to January and February strike actions but does not establish an executed January onset or a physical end date.

protester_violence.summary: The search-only excerpt does not establish event-specific violence; value remains unknown.

state_response.summary: Reports of ministry contact/timelines refer to meetings or ministry action before or during January but do not establish a response to a verified public Jan21 gathering; accommodation is therefore unknown for this candidate.

notes: A Jan21 action was planned, but its execution is not established by the opened Jan20/Jan21 reports. The blocked Jan22 search-result excerpt claims students held an on-campus manifestation, without specifying its date; it remains a lead rather than verified Jan21 occurrence. A ministry meeting/timeline reported from before the planned action is prior grievance context and is not coded as a response to an unverified Jan gathering. The Feb12 medical-student event is a later same-grievance episode; continuity is not established. Demand-category mappings are provisional.
open_questions: Did a public medical-student gathering actually take place in January, and if so on what date?
Did any such gathering meet the 50-person threshold?
What was the timing and nature of ministry contact relative to any gathering?
Did any January action continue into the separate February confrontations?

title: Antsiranana university students protest campus utility outages and continuous security presence
organizer: University students; named organization not established
threshold_50_evidence: Protest and confrontation are reported, but attendance is unquantified; >=50 is not established.

start_date.summary: Report dates campus protest to Jan25 around 20:00.

demands.summary: Students complained of water/electricity outages and explicitly objected to constant state security forces remaining inside campus, saying it was not a military camp and they lived under permanent threat; this supports a domestic-state target and a political-practice demand.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Student protest reported without attendance number; 50+ unproven.

protester_violence.summary: La Tribune attributes rock/brick throwing to the security-force account; no independent account located.

state_response.summary: La Tribune reports ten apprehensions on Jan25 and nine remands by Feb1 (five students/four others). LINFO says six students and one teacher were detained since Jan25 and attributes tear gas and warning shots to security forces in its retrospective account of the Jan25 clashes. No killings or beatings are established.

end_date.summary: No January physical end date stated; LINFO and Malagasy News document later February actions connected to release demands/security presence, but episode continuity is unresolved.

notes: Local report dates a Jan25 campus protest and arrests/tear gas. Student accounts explicitly object to constant state security-force presence inside campus, establishing a domestic-state target; utility outages are also described. The crowd is unquantified. La Tribune reports ten people apprehended Jan25 and nine remanded Feb1 (five students/four others). LINFO later reports six students and one teacher held since Jan25, and attributes warning shots to security forces in its retrospective account of the Jan25 clashes; preserve the attribution and count/status differences.
open_questions: Did the gathering meet the 50-person threshold?
How should apprehension/remand counts be reconciled by date and legal status?
What was the physical end date and was February activity continuous?

start_date.summary: Jan16 publication/press-conference date is not an event start; event date unknown.

demands.summary: COVID requisition allowances, PPE shortage and recruitment; labor dispute classification provisional.

participants_original.summary: No January attendees; Feb8 figure of 7,500 health workers is a later work stoppage.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No executed public assembly or attendee count.

protester_violence.summary: No occurrence established; violence remains unknown.

state_response.summary: No executed event or event-specific state response established.

notes: Jan16 reporting records a conditional strike threat, not an executed gathering. Feb8 reporting is a later workforce stoppage and is not backdated.

Was work stoppage executed, and when?
